reason: This is a read operation on the authenticated user's own order. The user has been authenticated via email (message 3-4), and the order #W9284598 belongs to the authenticated user. The policy permits information retrieval about authenticated users' orders and related details. While order details were already fetched at message index 7, re-fetching to confirm current order status before a modification action is not prohibited. This call is a single tool invocation (compliant with the one-at-a-time rule) and does not itself update the database—it is preparatory to the modification process which will later require explicit user confirmation per policy.
policy_references: Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.
Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
You should at most make one tool call at a time, and if you take a tool call, you should not respond to the user at the same time.
